t: Find a giant oyster shell, capable of containing a Cycling Potion, and bring it to Elchana at Kahlua Island.

I made a special potion to speak with spirits. Whoever wants to talk to them should help me. Spirits talk only about hardships, so we won't bother them for nothing!
The Potion is prepared according to an ancient recipe. A hundred moons waned and waxed a hundred times, since we found out about the power of four! They keep us safe and protect our people, but talk only to the witch. I don't care whether the seeker of spirits wears white feathers or red. This is no man's land, there must be no squabbles!
The Potion needs a special vessel – a big shell. Very big! Find the shell and bring it to me, I'll make a potion.

A fish's splash, a wolf's leap.
A hiss of rain, a stomp of feet.
A howl of wind, an ocean's croon.
Nothing is eternal under the moon!

Kug quag, wingless one! You've brought a good shell. Pure, smooth, big. The potion is very strong, it can turn a regular jar into sand in a heartbeat. Only a pure pearl, born in saltwater, tempered in a roaring storm, warmed by hot sun, may hold the magic elixir.
Collect 5 sea creature scales, 5 handfuls of fertile soil, 5 bird feathers and 2 drops of enemy blood, and bring them to Elchana at Kahlua Island.

While you were looking for a vessel, I did some prepping – I boiled tinctures, evaporated them, mixed the resulting extract with rare decoction. But the spirit seeker must get the last component. Listen and remember!
It shall be just like a sea creature, slithering in the ocean, fed by water.
It shall be like a free-spirited bird, circling in the air, carried by wind.
It shall be like soft clay, hard as a rock and porous like sand, fed by earth.
And enemy's hot blood must wash the hand of the one whose heart burns with untamed fire!
You should collect all four symbols of elements. Don't buy, trade, or receive them as gifts. Get them yourself. Only then the spirits may hear your request.

Hot wind with briar
Smells like an open prairie...
Wash with a cold wave
A hand that spills blood!
Yes! I sense the power of four elements behind you. Spirits await you!
Collect 5 sea monster scales, 5 handfuls of fertile soil, 5 sea bird feathers, 2 drops of enemy's blood and bring them to Elchana on Kahlua Island.

While you were looking for a vessel, I did some prepping – I boiled tinctures, evaporated them, mixed the resulting extract with a rare decoction. But the last component must be gathered by the spirit seeker. So, listen and remember!
It shall be just like a sea creature, slithering in the ocean, fed by water.
It shall be like a free-spirited bird, circling in the air, carried by wind.
It shall be like soft clay, hard as a rock and porous like sand, fed by earth.
And enemy's hot blood must wash the hand of the one whose heart burns with untamed fire!
You should collect all four symbols of elements. Don't buy, trade, or receive them as gifts. Get them yourself. Only then the spirits may hear your request.

Hot wind with briar
Smells like an open prairie...
Wash with a cold wave
A hand that spills blood!
Yes! I sense power of four elements behind you. Spirits await you!
Ignite ritual torches erected on Kahlua Island, then return to Elchana.

Al khakar tugat! Kuratag tak maggar! Cough... I sense darkness, Son of the Wind! Terrible darkness from eternal void. It follows you with hungry eyes, smells your scent, craves your body. Umm-tala... I know what to do!
Darkness is afraid of the sacred flame. Like a bonfire in the night that protects a hunter from wild beasts, so will fire above the altar protect you from the night's spawn. You will ignite the sacred flame at altars, and it will protect you during the ritual. Go!
Night spawns are dangerous. They come deep at night and leave neither feathers nor bones of careless fools, but bring no harm to cautious sages!
Good. Fire's burning and eternally hungry spawn of night returns to its lair. Nothing can interrupt the ritual.
Catch a Stout Tapir, a Sharp-toothed Moray, a Giant Albatross and a Bloodthirsty Sundew with a magic sack and bring them to Elchana as sacrifices to elemental spirits.

Al khakar tugat! Kuratag tak maggar! Khamaz tak karrak!
Tuar kra durrat! Sakhat khamar ulkrat!
...
Spirits don't want to talk to you, wingless one. You smell of a foreign land. You were not born winged and spirits don't trust you. But do not despair! Spirits are strict, but I know what to do. We will give them sacrifices! Just as good presents soften even the strictest judge, so will good sacrifices soften even the most vicious spirits.
I'll give you a magic sack, which can hold more than you could think. You will find a sacrifice, stuff it in the sack and bring it to me. I will take the sacrifice out of the sack and offer it to spirits. Then spirits will be satisfied and agree to speak to you.
Did you catch the requested animals?
Good. To be honest, I did not believe that this ripped sack I gave you still worked. I wanted to throw it away... Anyway, now we can continue the ritual!
Protect the witch while she performs the ritual.

Al khakar tugat! Kuratag tak maggar! Sakhat khamar ulkrat!
Ktatak ulu graa! Kugar! Kotar! Ko-karr!
...
I sense spirits, Son of the Wind. They hurry to my call. And they are furious! Terribly furious! But you should not be afraid! Elements are always willful and threatening. They don't like it when a mortal calls to them. Storm crushes a rock, wave washes away the city, fire burns a forest, and earth shakes and destroys the strongest fortress. But the wise are always more powerful than elements. They can subdue an element, make it serve them, like fire burning in hearth, water irrigating fields, wind rotating mill blades, and earth producing grain. If you tame a young elemental spirit, a mature spirit will speak with you.
They are already near. They want my blood and flesh. They want to rip apart an old dumb witch who challenge them. But you are strong, you can protect me, tame a young spirit and receive a blessing from every element!
But we have won! It was long ago when the spirits last responded to my call. I was very young and dumb chick and almost died. You are a strong warrior and spirits respect you.
You are such a klutz, you couldn't even protect me!
Enter the Cave of Elements located under the waterfalls, and meet with the wise Kutal Silver-Tongued.

Now you have the right to enter our sacred cave, Kotal-Khoorlan, where spirits of elements live. Kutal, an old wise aviak, will meet you there. You will receive blessing from caves for your people and obtain power of the elements for yourself. Only the Chosen One may enter our cave and obtain true power!
The cave will have incarnations of all four elements: fire, water, wind, and earth. Touch them and you'll obtain great power. Hurry! Old Kutal does not like to be kept waiting.
Quarr, outlander. I heard about your deeds. Do you wish to receive power of elements?
Pass all of Wind Master's trials and meet Sea Master at the Isle of Singing Water.

You were sssuccesssful at finding thisss place. I sssenssse your ressstless, freedom-loving sssoul. You will have my blesssing as sssoon as you passs all my trialsss!
If you sssucceed, your path will take you to the Isle of Sssinging Water. My brother, the Sssea Massster, lives there. He will guide you further on your difficult journey.
The waterfalls sang me your name, mortal creature...
Was your travel easy? A thirst led you here... Thirst for power, might and glory? Or some other thirst that cannot be quenched even by waterfalls?
Collect 10 giant feathers from albatrosses who live among the cliffs, then bring them to Sea Master at the Seven-Winds Cliff.

You want my blesssing, don't you? Then I would like to tessst you!
There are giant albatrosses among the cliffsss. These are powerful birdsss, capable of ripping to piecesss those who are weak of body. They are born of the wind. The wind isss their life, flesh and blood... Can you overcome these predatory birdsss? Will you cower before precipitousss cliffsss? Will your head grow dizzy from their heightsss? We shall sssee...
Get me albatross feathersss. Thisss will be your firssst trial!
I'll twissst you... I'll sssmite you...
Ha... You were able to complete my tasssk. Not bad for a wingless one. Perhapsss the old witch wasss not wrong about you...
Trap Breeze blowing through the atoll into the Wind Catcher's Bag and release a storm at the top of the Seven-Winds Cliff. Report to the Wind Master about the task completion.

Hear my sssecond tasssk, mortal.
Have you heard the legend about the wind catcher? There isss an old proverb... Whoever sssows the wind shall reap a ssstorm! And that'sss not a joke. Wind isss born free and isss difficult to catch... And to keep it isss imposssible!
Take my bag. You can capture in it a young and ssstupid breeze that blowsss through thisss island. But don't even hope to hold it long. Hurry to the top of the cliff and releassse the foolish wind... and you will sssee how powerful even the weakessst wind isss, if you trap it!
You were able to sssurvive the fury of a ssstorm... Good! The sssecond trial isss complete!
Slay the giant living at the Seven-Winds Cliff and blow the horn, then return to the Wind Master.

Here isss the third trial that I am tasssking you with. The mossst difficult!
An old giant livesss here, on the cliff. Hisss name isss Kean the Thunder-Roar, and every morning the sssound of hisss war horned, proclaiming my glory, can be heard above the sssea. But hisss time long hasss passed, and he wishesss for death... It isss not right for sssuch a powerful creature to die from old age. Giantsss like him mussst die like warriorsss, with weapon in hand!
Climb to the top of the cliff and challenge the giant. If you can ssslay him in battle, blow hisss horn, proclaiming my glory, and you shall receive my blessing!
An old horssse won't spoil the harvest. Isssn't it what you mortalsss sssay?

I heard the horn. You have the valor and courage of the giantsss. Let Kean the Thunder-Roar ressst in peaccce - the lassst echo of hisss horn will forever be carried by the wind. You completed your trial!
Burn the anarchists' forge, warehouse, headquarters, kitchen and barracks on the Freedom Island, blow up 70 anarchist aviaks and then report your success to Cha Pie-Pie in the Steel Claw village.

Quarr, Son of Heavens! I heard you know how to handle a squawker. Then I have a task for you.

Wingless people know how to make boom powder! Very loud boom! Have you ever deal with such powder, Son of Heavens? Kulgar kutar! Very well!
People of Heavens can fly, but are afraid of boom. Wingless is not afraid of boom, but cannot fly. Son of Heavens can ride a squawker and is not afraid of boom. So you can help us.
There is camp of foolish aviaks on Freedom Island. They call themselves anarchists. They are pain in the butt! They build forge, make weapons, and rob the Steel Claw. Brazen anarchist!
I'll give you a squawker. A squawker can fly to Freedom Island. I will tie sacks with boom powder to the squawker, so that you can drop sacks on stupid anarchist heads. Boom! And only feathers remain from anarchist! Son of Heavens will make a great deed!
Boom! And only feathers flew! It was beautiful...
I heard a boom from here. Anarchists will not be the same for a while. Excellent work! I will tell the whole guild about your deed and prowess!

Burn anarchists' forge, warehouse, headquarters, kitchen and barracks on the Freedom Island, explode 70 anarchist aviaks and then report your success to Karrok Stout-Hearted in the Glittering Wing village.

Quarr, Son of Heavens! I heard you know how to handle a squawker. Then I have a task for you.

Wingless people know how to make boom powder! Very loud boom! Have you ever deal with such powder, Son of Heavens? Kulgar kutar! Very well!
People of Heavens can fly, but are afraid of boom. Wingless is not afraid of boom, but cannot fly. Son of Heavens can ride a squawker and is not afraid of boom. So you can help us.
There is camp of foolish aviaks on Freedom Island. They call themselves anarchists. They are pain in the butt! They build forge, make weapons, and rob the Steel Claw. Brazen anarchist!
I'll give you a squawker. A squawker can fly to Freedom Island. I will tie sacks with boom powder to the squawker, so that you can drop sacks on stupid anarchist heads. Boom! And only feathers remain from anarchist! Son of Heavens will make a great deed!
Boom! And only feathers fly! Beautiful...
I heard boom from here. Anarchist not recover soon. Excellent!
Take away the aviak shaman's bones from the leopards living on the Copper Isle and return them to his grave.

Quarr... Outlander...
Narri was my name... I died not long ago... Descendants do not take care of my grave at all. Wild beasts dig up the grave and steal bones. It weakens me a lot... My spirit's strong, but my body's d decaying... Please return me my bones and put them back in my grave... My spirit will become stronger and I'll finally rest in peace. I'll be very grateful... A good reward I'll give...
Khar kual... It is always cold in the afterlife...
An outlander returned bones... Good outlander. Ungrateful descendants completely forgot about this grave... An outlander took care of the grave... What is the world coming to?
Find 2 silver coins in bird nests and return them to Narri, the shaman's ghost on the Copper Isle.

I ask you outlander one more favor... People of the Wind have a tradition – to give silver eyes to dead, that is to cover eyes with two silver coins. Silver is pure, magic... Cough... Silver eyes will see through darkness of ages... The old shaman's spirit will protect the people of the Wind from sudden troubles. The spirit will come to young shaman in dreams and alert him of trouble... When the young shaman dies, he'll take Narri's place...
Wild beasts dug up the grave... Cough... Dumb birds stole silver eyes... Stole both eyes... I cannot see anymore... I became blind... I cannot foresee troubles without my silver eyes... A young shaman is healthy. He won't die for a long time... No one can foresee troubles...
Will you help me?.. Help the people of the Wind... Return silver eyes!
Without a silver eye, I'm merely a blind chicken...
Now Narri can see again! And take care of my people...
Collect 30 beautiful albatross feathers, 5 giant pearls and one giant crab shell. Return them to Narri, the shaman's ghost on the Copper Isle.

I ask you outlander one more favor... Cough... It's not important... And yet it's very important!
Let's talk about graves... A totem protected the grave. It scared wild beasts, greedy birds, and evil spirits away... But the totem won't work anymore. The grave's almost in disrepair. Wild beasts steal bones again; dumb birds steal eyes again... Very bad... Do you outlander want a reward? If only you refresh the totem... collect feathers, sea moon, and a beautiful shell...to make a new totem. A powerful totem! Cough...
The totem will protect the grave... Scare away wild beasts...
Defenseless golem... all efforts for naught...
Repair the shaman's grave on the Copper Isle and receive your reward.

You did everything... Cough... Found bones... Returned eyes... Collected totem gifts... You're good. I'm grateful. I'll look into future... Cough...
You will repair the grave now while I'm looking into the future. If there's a trouble, I'll warn you outlander...
This is not a complete reward yet... Shamans are always laid to rest with good stuff, though they are useless in the afterlife! You can take anything you like.. And I'll look...

Outlander... Listen to what old Narri has to say...
I see two betrayals... One from an enemy... One from a friend...
The enemy has already betrayed you... If you don't see it coming... I cannot tell what would happen... It's dark and chaotic... Cough...
And the second betrayal will happen... From a friend... It will be sudden... You'll see it, but it will be too late... A strange betrayal... It can be for the worse or for the better... Everything's in your hands... Cough...
Now you should leave... I'll be finally at peace...
Ask Maxim Verevkin about what happened.

It's the end of the road for your cap'n. He suffered enough, poor bastard. The mast fell right on his head. Only a bloody spot remained on the deck. You also had your share, I see. A corpse in a coffin looks better than you.
So, listen. While you are pulling yourself together, I'll tell you what's going on. My name is Maxim Verevkin. I am the first mate on Vlad - the flagship of our strike squadron of the first Imperial Navy. Former flagship, that is to say. Only a wreck remains of our ship, the first to enter the wormhole. But all the other ships... not even a trace of them. Haven't seen losses like this since... well, ever!
Listen carefully, I don't have time to yack with you. There are still plenty of wounded to care for.

So this is what's happening with gibberlings... Looks like the other ships of our squadron had no chance of making it. Oh well. The Empire is where its soldiers are. We'll persevere! It ain't our first time!
Exterminate 10 morays eels around the shipwreck site and report to Melor Luzhin.

Tropics... I hate tropics! Just look at the local sea - the predators are all piled up on top of one another! Truly, this is no tropical atoll. The worst I saw was this enormous fish with finger-length teeth! If a beast like that grabs hold of your leg, get ready to limp for the rest of your life. I only saw them before in pictures. Gibberlings call them morays.
I fear that these beasts will start feasting on us... Chase them away! Morays have a cowardly reputation, so if you manage to kill ten of them, the rest will learn to keep their distance.
Whoa! Who bit you like that? Morays? There is no rest from them!

So have you managed to chase morays away? Excellent! Now we can walk in shallow waters without fear of losing our feet. By the way, don't forget to take care of your wounds. Morays' teeth may contain all sorts of things. You may even get some disease from their bite.
Take away the stolen sextant from the impudent crab and return it to Maxim Verevkin at the shipwreck site.

Hey... I don't feel comfortable bothering you, but there is nobody else to ask. Most people are still not themselves or extremely busy. Anyway, somewhere in this area I lost my sextant. It's this thing to measure angles and positioning in the Astral. I was using it to calculate the angle of the fall and determine the wormhole's exit location. I made my measurements, put the sextant on the barrel, turned my back to record the results, and lo and behold, the sextant was gone! I only saw some crab running toward the nearest stone. Perhaps that bastard stole my sextant! It is shiny and crabs like shiny objects.
Help me out, find me the sextant, what do you say? I will be in your debt! Being a navigator without a sextant is like being without hands.
There's plenty of local fauna... There are 15 types of mosquitoes alone. And all these bastards bite!
Wow, my sextant! Thank you very much. I'll try to take measurements again, but I think it is futile. It looks like this place contradicts all known laws of astralo-physics.
Find 10 surviving sailors in shallow waters and the missing bosun, then report your success to Anna Borzukina.

So, what do we have here? Hold still, let me take a look!
Swelling, bruises, scrapes. No sprains or fractures. That means you are going to be just fine. And since you are healthy, then you can certainly perform nurse's duties!
What? No, no need to take care of bedpans. You need to save those that still can be saved. After they hit the ground, people fell overboard like bowling pins! Many could have survived. That's why I want you, and others who are still able to move, to search and rescue the fortunate ones.
Also, it would be nice to find a surviving officer. A bosun, for example. I recall that a huge orc was a bosun on this ship. He was rude and impudent. Always wanted to pick a fight with me. Even a shipwreck would not have hurt such a hard-headed cretin too much!
Well, have you managed to save anyone?
Great! That was my last ration of mirra. I dread a trip to the Purgatory without it.
Meet Ian Down-and-Out on the Isle of Singing Water.

Gold is a sacred metal for aviaks. White aviaks try to hide gold from Steel Claw. Warriors catch up with white aviaks and fight! Many white aviaks were killed, but a glorious victory did not help us in finding gold. Damned monarchist hid gold. Gold is for everyone, it must belong to all laborers, not to a few white exploiters!
Last battle occurred at the Isle of Singing Water. And the map points to that isle! White tyrants probably hid gold on that island. If Red Avengers find gold, it would be a great deed. Proletariat will have high morale and happily fight in the name of revolution!
Son of the Wind should go to Ian. Ian is also a Red Avenger. He scouts the Isle of Singing Water. You will easily find him. He will come to you when he sees your red feathers!
Quarr, wingless one! You wear red feathers, I see. That means you're also a Red Avenger!
Bring the broken arrow to Maxim Verevkin at the shipwreck site.

Ooh... Am I really alive? Cool! Cough, cough... I thought, this is it, the end!
Why the end? Because some treacherous bastard shot an arrow at my back, got it?! Almost croaked!
Anyway, we got hit pretty good. As soon as I came to life, everything was burning, smoking and crackling. I knew I had to hightail outta there before some beam came crashing on my head. So I got out and ran... I mean, for help. And then I spotted some fella behind those bushes looking at me. I motioned him to run... for help. But as soon as I turned, he shot me in the back... well... slightly below my back! I looked at my back and saw plumage. I only had time to grab the arrow and pull it out along with an arrowhead. And then dropped like an autumn leaf. Hurts, damn him!
But we, orcs, are a hearty race; it takes more than one arrow to bring us down, ha! As soon as I came round, I saw you...
Hey, have you seen the rat that shot me in the back? I'd shove that bow and quiver right in that bastard's throat! Ooh, just look where he shot me! I didn't even see clearly who it was. Maybe he wasn't even human at all. Hell knows who lives on this island!
Hey, go to the active commander and give him the remnants of this arrow. Maybe the two of you can figure out who was bold enough to hide behind the bushes with a bow and shoot Imperial soldiers in the back!
So, what is it? Sorry, I am too busy right now to talk. I need to tend to wounded.

What? Someone put an arrow into our bosun's haunch? Wow... And this is the arrow, as I understand? Familiar plumage...
You know, taiga owls, whose feather were used in this plumage, live only in Siveria. This means that someone from the League shot this arrow. Looks like my theory that the shipwreck somehow involves the League just got its first confirmation!
Meet political commissar Leonid Brelin at the Imperial Camp near Rumbling Bay.

Here is the order. Listen up! You will go to the surviving senior political commissar, Brelin. You will report to him details about the crash, the attack on our soldier, and that I've identified the arrow as belonging to League scouts. I don't want to hear any buts!
The political officer is leading the construction of a temporary camp. He will be happy to have extra hands there. Since you are shipwrecked, and your captain is gone with the ship, you will come under command of a superior officer. From now on, we can consider ourselves at war! That is all! Run!

Greetings, warrior. Why are you breathing so heavily? Were you galloping all the way from the shore?
Oh, you are from that recent shipwreck? My condolences... Today we all mourn our losses. As I understand, Verevkin sent you to us.
...
So, directly shot in the back? Oh my... Looks like the League's handiwork, indeed!
On behalf of the army commander, I give you our gratitude!
Find evidence of the League's presence on the Copper Isle and report the accomplished mission to Igor Kalinin in the Rumbling Bay settlement.

Greetings. I have an important task for you! The task, so to speak, is of governmental importance!
Your efforts to initiate contact with our potential allies is very commending, but let's not forget about our main mission. We cannot allow the League to secure a strategic advantage over the Empire. The standoff is only gaining steam here. And our mission is to strike first!
Unfortunately, the initiative right now belongs to the opponent. I heard from commander Cha Pie-Pie that the enemy was detected in close proximity to our site. I think there is a threat of a sudden attack on our camp. But I am sure that the Empire will retake the initiative and turn things around.
You are very well acquainted with this region, so I will assign you to a recon mission. Therefore, on behalf of the Committee, I am ordering you to scout a location near the Copper Isle, where the enemy was detected, and make every effort to determine the size of enemy forces.
Were you able to find evidence of the League's presence?
Aha, I knew you could do it! The map? I'll take a look.
Distribute 10 leaflets to the aviaks in Steel Claw village and report the accomplishment to Nadia Krupina.

Greetings. I heard that you were able to find a common ground with aviaks and even gain some renown as the hero who saved the deputy of the red commander himself? Excellent. Then you are just the right person to drill the main postulates of our ideology into the chicken brains of these savages. Imagine it, they don't want to listen to me! All they do is chirp behind my back: "that chick ain't no bird." The nerve of them!
Brelin personally ordered me to conduct propaganda to representatives of friendly nations. I am a navigator, not a propagandist! But, I can't argue with superiors. If they want you to do it, then you must. But what can I do if the aviaks don't even want to read the leaflets I had spend the whole night working on?
Well? Will you help me find a common ground with these winged creatures? Distribute the leaflets to them and ask them to read at their leisure. They trust you and probably will comply with your request!
How goes the propaganda campaign? I tried to remember all of the slogans that I learned at political science workshops.
So they read the leaflets? Did they understand their content? I just saw with my own eyes some young bird attempt to make a scout's cap out of the leaflet!
Collect 12 feathers of carnivorous albatrosses living at Rumbling Bay and bring them to Danick Break-Neck.

Quarr, Son of Heavens! I heard about you from Leck. Leck is my best friend! He told me a lot about your heroism. He told me that you saved Leck, risked your own life. Son of the Wind is a true hero! Such hero has place among Red Avengers!
What, wingless one never heard of Red Avengers? How can it be? The leaflet that wingless female gave us was about Red Avengers. It was about a group of young wingless people who fought damned monarchists. We also fight monarchists! White aviaks are our main enemy and oppressor of honest hard-working folk!
For now, there'll be three of us. Do you, Son of the Wind, want to be the fourth? You must want to be an elusive Red Avenger, yes? We also want to raid enemy camps, rob their caravans and beat up enemies wherever we see them! Just like in leaflets.
There's only one problem... A Red Avenger must have red feathers. It is a distinguishing sign of our squad! But the Son of the Wind is wingless, no feathers at all, not even small ones. That's bad... You must wear feathers. If you can't grow your own, no problem. There's many big albatrosses around Rumbling Bay. Albatross feathers are almost as beautiful as the aviak's. Collect albatross feathers and become a true Red Avenger!
There's no rest for us - we will burn but survive... Is that how it goes? If you burn, you will not live. If you burn, you will become charred meat, get no rest!
Good feather! Durable, long, beautiful. Only it's white. White Avenger... that can't be right. Hold on, let me think...
Dip albatross feathers into the blood of killed animals to make them red and return to Danick Break-Neck in the Steel Claw village in Rumbling Bay.

Think! Think how to make white feathers red!
Red is the color of blood. If you dip white feathers in blood, they will become red. And if you whisper right words, beast's spirit will enter feathers. The old shaman always said that word, since I was a tiny egg. It was a very powerful word, so powerful that all spirits fled from it. Even skittish females plugged their ears. That is how powerful that word was! The word is: "Taggar takkar ukh kurruk over kurrak into kagar, turluk kurlad." I don't know what it means. But it probably works!
You should find the beast. Not a weak beast, only a strong one, with a strong spirit and a hot blood. Then you should dip feathers into the blood of the killed beast, speak the word to enchant the spirit. I can make a beautiful crown from the enchanted feathers. You'll wear that red crown and become a true Red Avenger!
Did you bring red feathers? Red is the color of victory! Red is the color of our victory over white monarchists and tyrants!

Good feathers! Red as blood!
You can now wear red feathers and kill white monarchists. Red Avengers will spread our great red revolution on every island!
Collect 7 trophy blades, 7 hammers and 20 arrows on the Rumbling Bay battlefield, and bring everything to Xia Break-Neck.

We need to find good weapons to fight. But we only have hunting spears, light bows with two arrows for three of us. How do we fight without weapons? Peck monarchists to death with our beaks? Well, we could... a true red warrior can use his bare wing to drive enemy into the ground. But it is much more convenient to crack their heads with hammers! Bang! - and only feathers fly!
We need to find weapons. And I know just where to find plenty of weapons! There was a huge battle at the edge of this bay! Our glorious red army detected and destroyed the damned white aviak brigade. We took trophies, as much as we could carry, but a great many remained there! My sister Xia went there to collect weapons, but she's weak and cannot bring a lot of them back. You are strong and you can carry many weapons. We'll use white aviak weapons against them! Whatever you find, bring to Xia. Bring hammers, swords and arrows to Xia. We'll use everything!
Will you, Son of the Wind, join Red Avengers? Marvelous! Now we'll defeat all enemies!
Wow, so many weapons... So sharp and shiny... Now Red Avengers will defeat all enemies!
Destroy the Elven necromancer and his servants, find out what they were searching for in Rumbling Bay, and return to Xia Break-Neck.

You brought weapons just in time. I saw a strange creature nearby. It's very-very strange, I've never seen someone like this. A small wicked creature with a crate on the back, that stinks like a dead monkey who has not washed for ten moons before the death! Wicked dwarves are searching for something, very thoroughly. And they all take orders from a tall strange outlander. That outlander looks like you wingless one, but not exactly the same. That outlander has wings, though they are small and frail, and he cannot fly. He orders dwarves to dig the ground, so they dig it here and there, searching for something. As I fly high, they didn't notice me. Those dwarves are stupid, but evil and stinky.
Now Red Avengers have weapons and can defend ourselves, but we need to chase the dwarves away. Far away! Will you do it? Will you chase away the dwarves and the outlander for us?
Did Son of the Wind chase away a scary dwarf?

What a weird map... It was not drawn by an outlander! It was drawn by an aviak. Damned white monarchists! It's their map.
I understand! The map shows the location of a treasure. A treasure in a sacred chest. A chest with gold bricks!
Measure coordinates with the astrolabe at five locations near the Isle of Singing Water and the Irdrich shore. Return to Yasskul Naboo with the results.

So, Igor Kalinin sent you? And may I ask what the Committee requires of me? Just help? Pardon me if I don't believe it. I have an assistant to lug equipment from place to place and you cannot make the required calculations anyway. Well, if Kalinin wants to send his own trusted man to monitor my research, so be it. But know this: since you are now my assistant, I will not give you any slack!
That idiot I sent to measure coordinates with the astrolabe went missing, while data is needed right now. So, assistant, here is the astrolabe and a marked up map where you need to record measurements. Taking measurements is simple: stand in the indicated spot, guide the astrolabe pointer to the most outstanding reference point, say Giant's Claw, look through the viewer and record the number that you see. As I said - simple!
That's all. Now go, record measurements, and come back soon. We still have many things to do!
I need this information to compare the coordinates I know with the entrance coordinates of the wormhole. I can then draw a certain conclusion whether there are any differences or not.

Aha, there are the coordinates. Let's see now...
How odd! The data do not match any of my theories! Such disposition is simply impossible.
Were the coordinates accurately recorded? Do you guarantee that there are no errors? Hmm... Very well, let's try to correlate data...
Catch 5 Greedy Monkeys with a lasso and drag them to Ian Down-and-Out on the Isle of Singing Water.

Your help is just in time! I found a camp on this island full of damned white enemies! And there's another wingless outlander with them, not the Imperial one. They are looking for something. The whole island is dug up.
Xia says they be are looking for gold. That very gold that we took from the white monarchists, then lost, then obtained again and lost again? Four times it passed from claws to claws? Then I understand!
Red Avengers must recoup gold. But there are only two of us against many white enemies!
I think of using a very old trick. It is called the "mad monkey." Do you know such trick? Neither does the white enemy! To awe the enemy is the first step towards victory!
First, you must catch monkeys. You'll need quite many of them since they quickly spoil.
Here is a lasso. I'll show you how to catch the monkeys easily.
Have you already caught monkeys? No? Then you must hurry. Our enemy never sleeps!
Five monkeys? Not so many... Oh well, I think that'll be enough.
Collect 5 Hollow Bamboo Stems and 5 Sulfuric Stones and bring everything to Ian Down-and-Out on the Isle of Singing Water.

We have a monkey. Now let's make this monkey amazing! So that the enemy will be amazed and left aghast. Do you think a big bang will awe the enemy? Me too. So we will make a bang.
Many moons ago, wise Cluck Golden-Heart invented this entertainment - he filled a hollow tube with the sulfur powder and ignited it. The tube flew very high, higher than any aviak could, and shone like a bright star. We call it a firecracker. And then his dumb assistant Tun One-Legged forgot to make a hole in the firecracker for fire... That's how Tun One-Legged became legless. It exploded just like a real taq taggar! Do you understand my idea?
Bamboo grows here in abandance. Bamboo stems are hollow inside. There is a plenty of sulfuric stones here as well. Fill the bamboo stem with the ground sulfuric stone, plug it in both ends of tube and ignite - kaboom!
Why do we need a monkey? Kul ktar, you will soon find out.
Damned white monarchists want a war? Then they'll get it!
There is enough sulfur to blow all the whites and the outlander to smithereens!
Blow up 30 aviaks using monkeys with firecrackers, then find a chest with gold.

Monkey... Check... Firecracker... Check... Time to make a big bang!
So, why monkeys? Who do you think will throw firecrackers at the camp? I cannot fly, as white bastards are sharpshooters! So long as you run with the firecracker, ignite and throw it, you'll become like a porcupine. I know that you are a brave warrior, but why banging your head on the rock when you can go around it?
I will fasten a firecracker to a monkey. The monkey will go mad from the flaming firecracker and run into the enemy camp, If we release the monkey near it! And then, kaboom! Instead of the wicked white aviaks, you'll have plucked chickens!
Half the camp will blow up sky high, the other half will obviously forget about searching for gold. Then we'll calmly enter the camp and get what we've come for. It's as easy as pie. If we find the chest, it will be a great feat. All Red Avengers will become heroes!
Just be careful, wingless one. If a monkey explodes near you, you will learn to fly. Without any wings!
Outlander! Stop! I want to talk to you!

I'll give you a ring, a good one. Don't hit me, OK?
My name's Klesk. Klesk Dare-Devil. And I'm not from the Glittering Wing tribe! My disguise fooled you, just like it fooled many others. It's a good disguise!
Throw the chest into the Astral and tell Ian Down-and-Out on the isle of Singing Water that gold was not found.

You do not know our history and our culture. You are called Son of the Wind, but you still do not understand our people!
Gold is evil! You don't know how many good aviaks died for this wretched metal. Only a fool considers gold sacred. It is not sacred, but cursed!
There have been four battles over it. The white aviaks chased away the red, then the reds took it away from the whites, the whites slayed the reds, and the reds avenged. Blood flows freely for the sake of useless yellow metal. The war for the sake of gold is a mindless war, outlander. The war is always merciless. But when a brother fight against his brother, a son against his father, it is the most terrible mindless war! This war has no winner. Everyone is a loser!
If you wish our people well, then you must destroy gold. Throw it into the great emptiness! No gold, no stupid fight for yellow metal. To fight for freedom, for your people, for your tribe - that will be good. Fighting for gold is really bad!
If you are smart and noble, then throw that gold into the great emptiness right now. And tell those greedy reds that gold is lost forever. I'll tell the whites the same. Then there will be less reason to go to war!

What?! Gold is lost forever? How can it be... It's a sacred metal! Through many generations only a true chief could own this gold. It was simple - whoever had the chest of gold, he called himself chief. Even I could call me chief if I took gold from the whites! Now what kind of chief am I? I am Ian Down-and-Out, and I'll always be...
Oh well. If the reds cannot get gold, at least the whites will not get it either. Maybe it's for the better!
Collect 5 eggs and stones warped by the Astral, and return to Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water.

I have one hypothesis that may explain a lot. However, due to outdated measuring equipment and extremely large tolerances that I cannot reduce... Anyway, we will have to work just like in the old times, using any means available. Purely theoretically it is possible to identify some properties of the Astral that surrounds Irdrich indirectly, i.e. by its influence on matter.
Don't worry, you won't have to jump into the Astral. But, I must admit, that would have been an interesting experiment and even somewhat amusing for me, albeit not terribly productive. Therefore, you will still have to toil in the name of science and collect research material.
At the shore, where the Astral contacts hard matter, you may find minerals subjected to its erosive impact. While the albatross living near the shore are not warped, their eggs were likely impacted by the astral. So if you can collect ten warped minerals and eggs, then I can make some initial conclusions. I can find a reference point that may turn our understanding of the Astral upside down...
So where are my long-awaited samples? My work is at a standstill without them!

So, I have living and dead matter. It would be nice to acquire matter from demons living in the local Astral, but without ships it is impossible. Except by slitting the throat of some dumb assistant in the name of science and baiting demons with their blood.
Measure the activity of the mentioned animals that live on Irdrich and return to Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water with results.

While I will deal with your collected samples, I have a new task for you. Not a complex one, but rather nauseating. It befits you, ha ha.
See this thing? It is an intelligent Magic Activity Coefficient meter, abbreviated as iMAC. This device is simple as a brick and reliable as a hammer. However, this bastard is expensive! Thankfully, the Empire spares no expense in the name of science!
Anyway, take the iMAC and record measurements of magic activity of Irdrich's fauna. The process is really simple. Point the iMAC towards an animal, press this button on the top lid, and voila! Measure every animal you manage to catch. The more information, the easier it is to draw a conclusion.
That is all. Now go and don't interrupt my research.
Hello, what are you doing here? I am kind of busy with important research!

What? No, I could not have sent you for any samples! I am a microbiologist. I deal with bacteria! You know: small, wonderful bacteria that can be seen only under a microscope. Do you have a microscope? Of course you don't. I possess the only working microscope. Moreover, I've never seen you before in my life. And if this is just Kalinin checking up on me, then I don't have time for such nonsense!
Drink the invisibility potion, steal the research log from Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water and bring it to Igor Kalinin at the Rumbling Bay camp.

Hey! Be quiet and quit staring at me. Are you also annoyed by this fool, Yasskul Naboo? Sure, I get it that it's not polite to say that about your scientific leader, but most recently she really has been acting... well, strange! For example, she forgot that she had already sent me to measure coordinates. I wrote it off as her resentfulness and absent-mindedness, common to all scientists. But what I heard during her conversation with you is outrageous! What microbiology, for crying out loud?! Yasskul Naboo was at her time one of the best specialists in astral studies. One might say that her monographs opened a whole new chapter in this extensive branch of science. And then microbes... unexplainable memory gaps... Something isn't right here!
I... I feel kind of uneasy suggesting this... But I think that you should steal Yasskul Naboo's work log. She records all of the experiment data in there. It probably contains the results from the last scientific research that we performed on this island! And if my leader knowingly does not disclose information or deceives us, then the brass should know about it.
I have an invisibility potion somewhere from the emergency stash. Here, take it. The log is usually somewhere near Yasskul Naboo. Drink the potion, steal the log from Naboo when she's not looking, and bring it to Kalinin. Let's see what he will say!
Greetings. Where have you been for so long?

What? Are you sure you did not suffer a heatstroke? I remember exactly that I sent you with a package of orders for our research group that works on the neighboring island, not to help scientists in their research. They are sufficiently competent in their search of the next pill for stomach flu, caused by some local bacteria.
And what is this? A work log? Are you out of your mind?! This is the expedition's financial statement! Look: numbers in columns, abbreviated names. Accountability above all!
A work log... as if! Yes, of course, I understand that we need to be vigilant, but it needs to be a healthy vigilance, not acute paranoia!
Meanwhile, please visit our medical facility. Let the doctor examine you and prescribe some sort of a mixture that calms nerves...
Meet the mysterious stranger in the Cave of Elements under Sunny Cascade. But first you will need to receive Blessing of Elements from an ancient witch who lives on Kahlua Island.

Listen carefully and don't interrupt. And don't stare at me! I am visible only to you, I don't exist to others. So simply shut up and listen.
I know that you've already noticed people's strange memory gaps. That's just the tip of the iceberg. Let's just say it is a small error that made its way into robust calculations of our old acquaintance.
You probably don't remember me? Oh well. It is not important right now. What is important is that you know that you're in great danger. Let's just say that the owner of this paradise is saddened by your unbridled curiosity and wishes to get rid of you. Don't believe your eyes: everything surrounding you is a trap for naive fools, and the trap door just shut itself. Whether you believe me or not is up to you. But if you want to survive, then meet me in a place called the Cave of Elements, and I will show you just how deep the rabbit hole goes.
I thought that you would not come. Well, you made the right choice. I am not disappointed in you.
Kill 12 Mosquitoes on the Isle of Singing Water and return with victory to Sarbaz Fakhar.

Oh, these vampires got the best of me. I have no more strength left! No, not the kinds of vampires who invaded the Galleon Palace and made Historians suffer. I am talking about real vampires, the ones who sucked me dry and then started on lube oil in my prosthetics. Ooh, damned mosquitoes! There is no respite from them! Aviaks may not care since they are all covered in feathers, but I'm scratching myself silly all day and have bites as big as a fist. Local mosquitoes cannot be compared to the harmless Nezebgrad variety, which can be poisoned easier than calculating an integral. Local mosquitoes are the size of a dog! And if they bite you, it is very painful!
If you're heading into the jungle, I beg you to give them a passionate "hello" from me and a sword between their insolent faceted eyes. Let them know that you can't just bite a poor laborer of science!
Yesterday I wanted to protect myself with a mosquito net from these flying bastards, but they stole it and drowned it! I am just glad that they didn't drag me into some swamp...
Mosquitoes got it in their snouts? At least someone delivered good news today. Thank you!
Collect 5 butterflies, 5 green and 5 blue tropical bugs, and bring them to Sarbaz Fakhar on the Isle of Singing Water.

While my scientific leader is a prisoner of her personal scientific research, I decided not to waste time and create a draft of my own scientific work. No, not about the Astral. I am passionate about entomology! Irdrich is an unexplored territory for an entomologist. Native endemic types... I lack the words to express their beauty! It is a researcher's dream! The only thing is that I don't have time to chase after bugs with a net. Being a junior scientific assistant to a famous scientist, you know, does not leave me much time for personal research. All I hear is: "Get me, give me, go to hell, don't bother me..." If someone were to catch me at least fifteen local bugs and butterflies, I'd be ever grateful! I'd even mention their name in a monograph... in fine print... on the last page... in a footnote...
You cannot imagine how exciting it is to research pedipalps of some especially rare kind of tropical spider or drawn scales on the wings of a swallowtail butterfly!
Oh... Insects! Just look at those beauties. It's a breakthrough! It's not just a monograph, but a whole dissertation!
Cure 10 sick aviaks hiding in the jungle of the Isle of Singing Water with a universal vaccine and report to Sarbaz Farrakh.

Indeed, we were too rash in contacting the local population... I heard stories that isolated tribes are more vulnerable to diseases of the "outside world." There was a story about a lost colony of gibberlings that went extinct from measles after it made contact with an elven astral ship. And now I stumbled upon a similar immunity problem myself.
You see, I had a parrot aboard the ship. Just before the departure, it started sneezing and coughing. Just a bird flu, nothing special - a few drops into the beak, a thermometer into... the output orifice, and the bird is good as new. Bird flu, as follows from its name, is only dangerous to birds. And aviaks are obviously birds, only bigger and with no immunity to bird flu. And so our guides and porters, recruited from local winged population, got infected. The flu impacted them terribly: horrible inflammation, delirium, hallucinations... It's awful!
I tried to inoculate them with a vaccine, but it was futile. They started attacking anyone on sight! They've gone mad! I barely escaped with my life. But you are a hero and can easily subdue weak and sick aviaks. Will you help? I don't want to be the cause of a whole nation's demise. Winged ones, in contrast with the Arisen, don't have a chance for resurrection and eternal life...
Oh, I hope the pandemic will be prevented...
You were able to stop the spread of infection? Whew! A load off my mind! And a direct contradiction to the belief that heroes don't care for the problems of locals.

Collect samples of sea creatures living around the island: 7 sea turtle shells, 7 cnidaria's tentacles and 7 hides of sharp-toothed alligators, and bring everything to Sarbaz Fakhar on the Isle of Singing Water.

Besides researching the Astral, we also study local fauna. Well, at least I do. My scientific leader is bent on the Astral, its emanations, aberrations, and anomalies. While I am closer to the earth and interested more in biology rather than in astral sciences.
Presently I am attempting to classify the local sea creatures. Even though we are involuntarily imprisoned on this allod, there are a few benefits. For example, I can peacefully do my research... If only Yasskul Naboo wouldn't saddle me with her orders day and night! I, an adequately known entomologist, being ordered around like a rookie lab assistant without a scientific degree!
Listen, can you help me? Sooner or later you will stumble upon some local predatory creatures anyway. If you happen to kill some sea creature, drag its remains to me. The more, the better! I'll try to develop at least an initial classification from the remains, and then, when I free myself from serving our arrogant star of science, I'll create a proper catalog.
Well, how many sea creatures have you killed?

Do you have anything for me? A skin or a ripped out tentacle? Whoa! Skins, tentacles, and shells... Thank you very much. Now where would I find some formaldehyde to preserve at least some of these samples for science?
Slay the three-headed monster on the Isle of Singing Water and report about your opponent to Igor Kalinin.

Quarr, Son of the Wind! I want to thank you for saving lives of me and my friends! A strange disease turned us into wild beasts that pecked a healing hand. I want to apologize that my brothers and I attacked you! I was very sick and terrified. I was scared by a horrible monster that lives in the jungle. It's a very scary monster! I've never seen anything like it. A monster is small, but very fierce. It has three heads, I saw it clearly. Three heads, six arms, sharp steel claws, and it screams horribly. I was very scared.
My brothers have not come back from the jungle yet. I'm worried! What if the same monster has eaten them? But I'm sick and cannot search for brothers in the jungle. Will you help? Slay the monster! Kill it dead! Then my brothers can safely return from the jungle to our camp!
Greetings. Judging by your amazed look, you have very important news for me.

So... Gibberling seers are directly in front of the research expedition's nose... And what did I say! Exactly this! I insisted that those eggheads take a reliable security consisting of sailors trusted by the Committee. But no! "Your sailors would break valuable scientific equipment. They would distract us from our work and be a general nuisance!" Damn it! At least you were able to eliminate an enemy agent. But how can we be sure that there is no more of them? I will immediately order to double... no, triple the security! No Imperial secret shall reach our enemy!
Bang a gong in Rumbling Bay and summon a tamed squawker. Use it to fly to the top of the Giant's Claw, steal a squawker's egg and go back to Chewy Wind-Born in Rumbling Bay.

Quetal quarr, outlander! What brought you to Chewy? Do you want to learn? Then Chewy will teach you!
Do you outlander know squawkers? I'll explain. A squawker is a bird. Toothy, powerful and always hungry. Very smart, but very angry. It's hard to tame. But squawkers fly like lightning, faster than wind! If the wingless outlander wants to understand People of the Wind, you should tame a squawker. A mature squawker can't be tamed, as it's completely wild. An outlander must find a small squawker and tame it. Feed and care for it... Then a squawker will grow big and fly the outlander on its back. Then wingless one will become winged and understand our people!
Now wingless one should climb a mountain and hit a gong. A tamed squawker knows the gong sound well. Every island here has its own gong. As soon as a squawker swoops in, wingless one should climb atop the squawker and fly to Giant's Claw. Wild and angry squawkers live there. Outlander should look for a squawker's egg, then strike the gong and bring the egg back. Chewy will then help hitch... hooch... hatch... Tagar! Bring the egg and Chewy will tell you what to do.
Have you found a squawker's egg already?
That's good! I know what to do with an egg. Now wait, wait just a little.
Feed a squawkling with 20 chunks of raw meat and return to Chewy Wind-Born in Rumbling Bay.

Wingless one, listen to me now. I'll give you a bone whistle. Blow the whistle, and a squawkling will come. It's small and hungry. It gonna eat like hell! A squawker is not a parrot, it doesn't eat fruits, only meat.
Go hunting, outlander, to get meat and feed a squawkling. When a squawkling grows very big, it will love you like its parent. It'll carry you on its back up high in the sky! Then you will understand and trust our people, or even make friends with us!
If you feed a squawker well, it will love you and fly you high. But if you do not feed it well, it might become angry and bite you.

Kamul kutlak, wingless outlander! A squawker is like wings for yous. Now you wingless one may bang a gong on any island and summon a squawker. A squawker will easily fly to the gong, soar high and fast. You will become a true Son of the Wind!
Meet Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower.

Hello! You have an urgent telepathogram from Rysina herself!
Elizaveta Rysina orders all Imperial heroes to come to the Committee headquarters immediately. Order priority - highest, secrecy - four zeroes. So run to Rysina without delay!

Greetings, hero. You already took an oath and signed an NDA regarding government secrets, so let's skip the bureaucracy. I'll be straight with you. The Empire needs heroes now more than ever! I sense big trouble coming and the only ones who can deal with it are heroes, just like you.
Meet captain Mackin in the Nezebgrad port.

Strange code... Pah! This one is not a letter at all. It is a drawing that kids doodle on walls! Fine, we'll see what we can do. I personally will find the one responsible for it and rip his arms off!
Meanwhile I have an important task for you. No one can succeed in this task but you, so consider yourself volunteered!
Anyway, we have an experimental ship here. A secret development! The world's fastest ship. I've decided to send it after the fleet. The ship has excellent armor and its cannons are capable of making a hole even in an astral island! If anyone can find our lost fleet, it is only this ship's crew under the command of an experienced Committee agent. This means you. The ship has already departed, but that doesn't matter. It has a special item on board, a teleportation device, so just say the word, I'll press the button and you'll be aboard the ship.
Oh yeah... The last communication received stated that an armada of demons is attacking the ship, so be prepared for the battle!
So you are the authorized Committee agent that keeps an eye on us? I hope you have a strong stomach. It's going to get hot!
Use a ship cannon to shoot down attacking demons.

We are getting close to the wormhole that leads into the sector where the squadron was lost. No rest from the demons. We're barely afloat and...
Demons! Demons attacking again! Fire in the hole! All hands on deck!!!
Astral take them, we'll have to blindly jump into an unknown sector, without preparations! Light save our souls!
What are you doing here? Grab a cannon and show those astral shrimps how things are done in the Empire! We just need to get through to the wormhole, and then we're in the clear!
How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?

Glory to the Martyrs... At least someone came to life! What a crash! Half of the crew is unconscious, the other half is in the Purgatory. Damned demons! This is the first time I see a wormhole directly above an allod. And here is your captain... dead... he did not expect such a surprise.
Go to the Purgatory with Rysina's help and talk to the Servant of the Light.

Lately, I am beginning to think that we are waging a war on several fronts. Nihaz has been defeated, long live the heroes and so on, but I sense that problems are just coming up...
Recently I was given a message from this bourgeois, a goblin from the Purgatory. You see, he is worried about the presence of some strange Sparks in his neck of the woods. Allegedly, they cannot return to their bodies but nevertheless do not dissolve into the great void, and act like sleepwalkers, wandering around the netherworld and scaring those who are awaiting their turn to be resurrected.

Hey! Wanna jump the line?!
Wait a sec... I remember you! You're that hero who helped the goblins and the ghosts on Gipat! You were sent by Elizaveta Rysina, right? Thanks Light! This is very handy!
Inspect the lost Sparks in the Purgatory and find out what happened to them. Report the information to the Servant of the Light.

Oh, something's rotten in your kingdom, yep! Look at those poor souls restlessly wandering through the Purgatory. Empty eyes, empty heads... The horror!
I don't know what happened to them. They appeared in the Purgatory already like this, with neither will nor power. I tried to talk to them, shake them, but to no avail, yep. They talk nonsense. I saw crazy Sparks before, and all of them would leave this sorrowful place after a certain time... But not these, they wander around here, scaring the dead, and cannot return, as if they are stuck between life and death. Perhaps you can try to talk to them? It is not good that our set routines be interrupted by some lost souls, yep.
So that's how it is! Cultists, then... I think it's time to warn Elizaveta!

Hm, it means that I'm dead, all the same. I must admit it' not very pleasant. Last time I did not feel anything, now I feel... weakened.
I fancy if this state is caused by the artifacts we have found in the sealed crypt at ZIT... It is worth thinking about. It seems I died there, at ZIT...
Alright, off you go. We'll meet again soon, anyway...
Alright, off you go. We'll meet again soon, anyway...
Talk to Negus Tot at ZIT.

Very well, I will personally write a note to Elizaveta, and you have more important business awaiting you! Go to the mass grave, which your Arisen call ZIT, and find my old buddy, Negus Tot. This narrow-minded skeptic knows everything that's going on in the old pyramid like the gears in his prosthetics. I hope that, with a joint effort, you can help me solve the problem with the Sparks that lost their bodies and memories. It's not good when a Spark exists without a body. It is unnatural!

What? You were sent by the goblin from the Purgatory? I don't believe my ear drums... That greedy goblin is asking our help? That's unheard of!
Well, tell me everything, while I think about what we can do.
Meet Yaver Gaudi in the ZIT's sealed crypt.

So that's how it is... It is somewhat clearer now!
Several days ago we found a thoroughly hidden and sealed room in the pyramid, that is in ZIT's main wing. With utmost care, we opened it and were stunned: it was packed with devices that we never knew existed! Tep's heritage... You cannot imagine the thirst of knowledge that is ignited in the heart of any scientist upon hearing those words!
I myself don't participate in research. I have enough to do as it is. Yaver Gaudi is leading the research. Go to him and give that modernized crocodile a message that I order him to support you in your research.
Hey! Who are you, plague take you! Access is granted only to category two clearance!
Ask Yaver Gaudi about the circumstances of death of the Arisen stuck in the Purgatory, and return to Negus Tot.

Access only by permission from Negus Tot! Forbidden to unauthorized personnel!
What? Negus Tot sent you? He even said "modernized crocodile"?! How dare he! Very well, I'll deal with him later.
What do you want to know? We value every minute here.
So, the Spark of a slain one is stuck in the Purgatory? And that poor soul died here, in the crypt? Hmm... Damnation! I shouldn't have used Master's weapon... What terrible luck! I thought that we did everything perfectly, but now I find out that some curious bastard died and appeared in the Purgatory...
That's bad, very bad. Now I won't be able to transport Master's valuable equipment quietly. Well... As they say, nothing personal, just business! Master will make use of your Spark as well!
Well, were you able to find out about the Arisen stuck in the Purgatory?

What?! Tep Cultists, under the guise of ZIT employees, were preparing to take valuable equipment and attacked you?
I can't believe it... Do you have any proof?
Report to Yasker about the cultists' schemes.

The papers that you took off Yaver Gaudi's body... Their contents scare me!
Why would Tep need live prisoners? Aside from inhumane experiments. And how is it connected to the lost Sparks in the Purgatory? There are more questions than answers!
What was the security service doing? And the infamous Committee, whose spies stick their noses into every vial in my institute, failed to detect a whole gang of cultists under their nose. I am partially to blame as well. I sensed there was something wrong when Yaver Gaudi asked for cart blanche in his research... He even personally selected his employees!
All right. Go to Yasker and report the liquidation of the spy cell. You are a hero, he won't execute you right away...
Cultists in the scientific center of the Empire... Imagine that!

Good day, comrade. I hope that you truly have important news, and not some rumors of an astral dragon that was seen above the Wild Isles by drunk shamans.
Wait a moment... So it was you who destroyed the cultists disguised as ZIT employees? Excellent. Wonderful. Congratulations. You've quite masterfully derailed a Committee operation aimed at infiltrating the spy network of Tep followers! Your interference roused all the spies and forced them to act before our detectives found all their contacts and locations! What are we to do now? Start from scratch?
Kill all Tep cultists, free hostages and return to report to Yasker.

Oh well, what's done is done. I'll have to assign you to this case as a detective. Listen carefully!
Yes, the Committee was aware of the Imperial citizens kidnapped by Tep's servants. The Spark of the Arisen that lost his memory and energy, whom you had a chance to talk to in the Purgatory, was obviously one of the kidnapped.
Yes, we did not interfere. The security of the Empire is more important than that of a private citizen and everyone understands it. If dozens die to protect thousands, that is a sacrifice I'm prepared to make! The Committee was prepared once and for all to purge our ranks, and would have succeeded if not for your meddling. Now, the cultists, understanding that they were detected, hit several of our posts and got away! They also kidnapped a number of our citizens. I hope you understand that this is largely on you! And it is on you to fix your mistakes!
The Blue Barracks were attacked by cultists. The cultists took several of our recruits hostage, but probably did not flee far. If you hurry, you might still save them! Run!
Hurry. If cultists escape with the hostages, their lives will be on your conscience.
Were you able to free our recruits? That's good news!
Kill Tep cultists on the Wild Isles, free the hostages and report to Yasker.

Right before your appearance, I received a report of another cultist attack on our citizens. It was on Wild Isles, of all places! Strange that enraged orcs did not rip them apart on the spot. Then again the report talked of strange shadows that inspire pure horror and kill with just one touch... Aren't those the spark snatchers that we've met on the Wandering Island? That might explain the Sparks' exhaustion in the Purgatory.
Then again, guessing never amounts to anything. I need facts and you shall provide them. And also save our guys, who are in trouble. Get to it!
Hurry. If cultists escape with the hostages, their lives will be on your head.
So orcs were right, and spark snatchers are collaborating with Tep's servants? I don't like this...
Kill Tep cultists at Eljune, free hostages and report to Yasker.

Besides the IMD, the cultists attacked our military camp at Eljune. Somehow they are interested mainly in physically seasoned citizens with high emotional stability. Those who are able to serve in the army. If I was not so confident in the loyalty of our citizens, I would have assumed that the cultists were planning to convert our recruits and make them Tep's watchdogs. But that's impossible! Loyal sons of the Empire will not serve the mad necromancer... though I am not sure about some Arisen. We will have to order Rysina to do additional checks among ZIT employees.
But that does not concern you. Your job right now is to free the kidnapped privates from cultists at Eljune. Hurry up and go. Time is against us!
Hurry. If cultists escape with the hostages, their lives will be on your head.
Excellent! Kidnapped privates will be awarded a resort vacation. Let them rest and forget about their misfortune. The Empire values its defenders!
Interrogate the port workers, find the traitor and confirm Crazystorm the Merciless' suspicions.

The Committee was able to neutralize all enemy spies. I trust you, but note that what I am about to say is confidential! This is classified information!
To resolve the cultist problem we were forced to ally with the League. It looks like old man Aidenus has similar problems in his neck of the woods. Since he understands that he cannot deal with Tep alone, he swallowed his pride and contacted me. We even signed a temporary joint effort agreement... Except that I am starting to suspect that he has some hidden agenda, besides his wish to forget about our squabbles and fight Tep!
The documents retrieved from ZIT revealed the hideout location of Tep in the far Astral. We were preparing a fleet for military action when Aidenus contacted me. As a result of our negotiations, we joined our forces and fleets. Our fleet, joined with the League's strike squadron, had reached the location at the wormhole that leads into an unexplored sector, and went missing! Crazystorm the Merciless suspects that the truce was a sly move by Aidenus to weaken our defenses and attempt to board Imperial ships, which were left without any additional support.
But fleet departure was prepared in utter secrecy! Even if someone did report about the departure of our armada, it would have been someone from the port or lighthouse personnel. I am ordering you to find this rat and rip the whole truth from him or her!

So that's how it is? The League spies are confessing their evil deeds before their death? Strange... They have never done it before! Oh well, let's assume that we can forget about a truce with the League. Let's take a look at the coded message, shall we?
Ask Nukah Scraggy-Bone to show you the way to the pangolin's lair, defeat it and brag about your victory to Arko Raw-Boned in the Steel Claw village.

I heard that you're a great wingless hunter. I know where to find a prey worthy of a legend! A terrible pangolin! Its roar makes trees tremble and its step makes earth quake. It is a real beast!
If you want to prove your valor, you should hunt the beast. Nukah Scraggy-Bone knows where beast's den is and he'll show you the way. If you kill the beast, I'll give you a nice reward!
The bigger the animal, the more glory for a hunter!
Good catch! You're a mighty hunter to fell such a beast. You'll get a good reward!
Fry 12 tapirs using the Amulet of the Fire Gaze and bring Glick 12 well-done steaks.

Hey, wingless one! Are you a hunter? Can you hunt? Kur-r! Good! I have a favor to ask. Do you want to help?
I'm a cook. My cooking is very tasty! You bet your beak it's tasty! And you outlanders eat a lot. Outlander have eaten everything I prepared. I have no more meat to feed such hungry outlanders. If outlanders want to keep eating, you must help me.
Take this fire amulet. A true flame lives inside it. When you find a tapir, a fat tapir, while hunting, hold this amulet tight and say a magic word. The amulet will emit flame and fry the tapir. It'll be a royal dish - tapir au jus!
Did the amulet work? Excellent! I had doubts... But as you are brave and quick, you got meat and tried the amulet. And not even fried yourself. That's very good!
Kill 12 leopards in Rumbling Bay and boast about it to Arko Raw-Boned in the aviak village.

Quarr, Son of the Wind!
It's time for a great hunt. When the wind blows from the south, and the waves break on the doorsteps of our houses, we begin hunting. We hunt great spotted beasts - leopards! Only the bravest can capture a leopard. Are you such a hunter? Then you can join our hunt!
A leopard is a fast and sly beast. It's growl often sounds around our village. We don't kill them for fun, we hunt to protect ourselves. Go into the jungle, kill leopards to protect our people, and protect your own people, too. It's good for everyone!
Spotted leopards are the most dangerous predators in our jungle!
Son of Heavens is a great hunter! Our people are proud of you!
This will be a tight fight! Good luck, wingless!
Bring 12 Milva Fruits and 12 Whoopgrass Roots to Zul Stamen in the Rumbling Bay village.

Koot nakar... Tukkar tak... Tri shar kudrag khanok... Whoa!
Why do you distract me? I've spilt all of the herb! Where do I find new herb now? Do you know? So you know how to bump a wing, but don't know where to get medicinal herbs?! Taggar sharrak!
Since you've disturbed me, you must help me!
Whoopgrass root is difficult to find. Go look for a curly grass with miniscule red flowers. Pull it out carefully, not to break root. It's simpler with milva. Simply shake the tree and fruits will fall to the ground. Pick the juiciest fruit and bring it to me. I'll discard its pulp, make a medicinal powder out of its pit, and mix it with the ground root. It'll be a potion potent to help with every illness!
Are you bumping my wing again?

Oh, you've found the needed herb. Much of it! Thank you so much!
Would you like new shoes? Your people make necklaces and shoes for People of the Wind. Necklaces are pretty, so I wear them. But why do I need shoes? You may take and wear yourself.
Find Leck Green-Horn in the Rumbling Bay jungle.

Wingless Son of the Heavens, did you see my young deputy? He's still a young, green-horned chick. Hence his name – Leck Green-Horn. Completely dumb and always getting lost! How can he become a real commander? Young'un, taggar kutar! His head is filled with rest and relaxation. And who will be serving in the army? Old Furr Wagging-Tongue, who can't even remember the business end of a spear? Or red commander Cha Pie-Pie must personally check the sentry posts? These young'uns are not the same as before, not at all... They don't understand ideas of our passionate revolution!
But we must find Leck. I cannot be without a deputy. Who will I send to the warehouse? Who will I order to write orders? Not you, right? I agree, you have more important matters, cannot be my errand boy. All I ask that you find Leck, grab him by tail and drag him here. He probably run off into the western forest, near the cliff shores. Young'uns always run off into those woods to meet with some female... I remember, I was myself like him, kul kaurr...
Oh, young chicks are stupid... You must keep a sharp eye on them!

This little rascal wanted to make me surprised and almost got eaten by leopard. I'll show him a surprise... He won't sit on his bum for a week! And forget about entertainment for a month!
But he told me an interesting thing. When he run, he saw a strange outlander. Wingless just like you, but... different. I don't know how to explain. We heard about another outlander from your commander. He calls them "League." Leck thinks he saw League outlanders. They were going somewhere towards the Copper Isle. Leck didn't see how many and why. Perhaps it's your League that lives there?
Kill the Bloodthirsty Leopard in the Rumbling Bay jungle and report its demise to Leck Green-Horn.

Hold it! Stay back! I'll defend myself until my last drop of blood! Oh... I don't have much blood left already...
What? You were sent by Cha Pie-Pie to find me? What a dumbass I am! My commander shows care, but I cannot care for myself... I let the commander down!
I wanted to surprise the commander. Commander's Hatching Hour will be soon, and I wanted to give him a present. A spear tip made from a big cat's tooth! I tracked down a very large cat. It's teeth are bigger than my beak. I sneaked up on it, shot at it, but that beast jumped and bit me! I barely escaped. Alas... I am weak...
You, wingless outlander, are very strong. Will you help me kill the beast? It's not right for a toothy cat to roam free! Today it has bitten Leck, tomorrow it will maul Xia, or steal chicks from our homes! Will you help slay a killer cat?
I've never seen such a big and angry cat in my life! Toothy creature!
Is the beast dead? Thank you, outlander! Wind take it and its teeth. It's good that the beast won't attack any aviak anymore. The jungle is a little safer now.
Lead Leck Green-Horn to the Steel Claw village.

I've lost a lot of blood... A toothy cat has broken all feathers in my wing. At least it didn't have time to bite off my bones - I hit it straight in nose and fled. But now I'm afraid to walk to the village. We aviaks do not walk well, but we fly well. When we walk, we're like a stupid chicken - funny and slow. You are wingless, you're comfortable on the ground, like a fish in the water. Will you help me and clear my road to the village? I'll be very grateful!
Oh those youngsters are brainless... Need thorough watch and care!
What dumb chick. I ordered you not to go hunting alone. At least you're alive...
Contact Yasker using the subspace communicator and report on the demise of the fleet.

The League is really something! They entered the wormhole ahead of us, prepared an ambush and met our defenseless ships with guns blazing. But how did they survive themselves if the wormhole opens up directly above the island? Baffling... It looks like we are stuck here for a long time. We have no ships and the remaining ones cannot be repaired... Communication is a problem as well. All right, I'll tell you one more military secret. At this point, what's one more secret to you anyway? We do have communication. Before the departure, the admiral, may he rest in the Astral, was personally handed from Crazystorm the Merciless the latest Imperial invention - a remote communicator that can contact the capital from any point of the universe. Fortunately, the device survived the shipwreck. Except that the charge won't last long.
Here, take it. Press this button, rotate this lever and imagine the person you want to contact. What do you mean "who to imagine?" Yasker, of course! We have to report our failure and bring him up to date. You can imagine him better, and you won't lose any stars off your lapels. That's why you should report!

So... As I understand, this is our experimental subspace communicator? Pretty, but dumb. We ought to considering cutting the budget for our R&D department.
All right, back to business. Report!

It is clear... that nothing is clear! Could the League have really taken the risk to play their game? We will think on it. Think long and hard. And, perhaps, execute some folk! But that does not concern you. For now.
Communication via this experimental transmitter is very unstable. I am spending my strength to smooth disturbances in the Astral. Try to find something that may stabilize the channel and contact me again.
